name: waterfront_build
doc: Builds a waterfront building on a lot that is part land, part water (small, medium, large; +z the water), from its type (a config entry: pier, boathouse, warehouse, fishery, with colours, boats, crane, nets, barrels, lamp), the water's drop, and the season: a quay wall along the shore, decks on posts, sheds, a crane over the water, net racks, moored boats rocking on their keels; its cells and which are wet, its box, and collision.
